content.stem: 联合国安理会的制裁旨在：

options.A: 包罗万象且广泛，必要时包括使用武力
options.B: 设计用于维护和恢复国际和平与安全
options.C: 旨在为一组国家带来经济利益
options.D: 惩罚性措施以影响外国政府改变其行为

content.stem_en: The United Nations Security Council's sanctions are intended to be:

options_en.A: Encompassing and broad, including the use of force if necessary
options_en.B: Designed to maintain and restore international peace and security
options_en.C: Indefinite to produce economic benefit for a group of states
options_en.D: Punitive to influence foreign governments to change their behavior
